IncidentBot: :rotating_light: INC-2026-0421 opened by monitoring - upstream routing error spike on /v1/generate, 30% error rate, latency 2-3x baseline. Smart-routing fallbacks increasing. Paging on-call.

Alex Chen: on it, paging in progress. Any known deploys?

Maya Patel: no deploys from infra, just a policy push to smart-routing config last night (policy v3) that changed variant precedence for EU.

Samir Khan: seeing a lot of requests being routed to `redwood-1b-q8` (quantized lower-capacity) instead of `redwood-7b-fp16`. Error traces show model-response mismatch -> timeouts after 15s.

Eva (SRE): can you paste a sample trace?

Samir Khan: ```
[2026-03-15T17:34:12Z] request_id=abc123 route=eu-west1 policy=smart-v3 chosen_variant=redwood-1b-q8 -> kv-cache miss -> slow kernel fallback -> downstream 504
[2026-03-15T17:34:13Z] fallback_attempt=region-fallback target=eu-west1-old -> queued -> rate-limit 429
```

Maya Patel: that's odd — policy v3 should prefer fp16 variants for low-latency profile. Maybe the variant selector mis-evaluated cost due to outdated perf profile for `redwood-7b-fp16`.

PD Bot: PagerDuty: Alex Chen acknowledged the incident.

Alex Chen: customer impact: a few enterprise customers reported failed completions and UI errors on chat. Severity P1. Need quick mitigation.

Eva (SRE): mitigation options: 1) force-model to `redwood-7b-fp16` for impacted routes, 2) revert policy v3 -> v2, 3) throttle traffic to the region and spill to US. Manual overrides have side effects - prefer surgical force-model on the route if acceptable.

Maya Patel: agree. I'll approve a targeted force-model on the `chat-production` route for eu-west1. Samir, can you run the override?

Samir Khan: executing now: ```/infra/override force-model --route chat-production --region eu-west1 --model redwood-7b-fp16 --reason "mitigate misrouted quantized variant"```

IncidentBot: Override executed by Samir Khan at 17:42 UTC. Policy evaluation re-run.

Alex Chen: seeing immediate drop in errors... wait, latency is spiking to 4-5x for some tokens.

Samir Khan: logs show a cascade: forcing to fp16 caused autoscaler to spin up larger instances in eu-west1 but the placement engine routed some warm KV traffic to a staging pool that runs a different fallback policy, which in turn triggers a region fallback back to eu-west1-old -> loop.

Maya Patel: ugh. So the manual override changed the routing graph and exposed a stale fallback route. This is a policy graph loop.

Eva (SRE): we need to break the loop. Options: revert the override (risky), patch fallback policy (slower), or apply a short-circuit rate-limit on the fallback path. I recommend adding a temporary `deny` rule for the old fallback target to stop re-entry.

Samir Khan: adding deny rule: ```/infra/policy patch --id fallback-eu-old --action deny --ttl 15m --reason "break loop"```

IncidentBot: Policy patch applied by Samir Khan. TTL 15m.

Alex Chen: monitoring... errors down to 2% and latency trending to normal. Customer reports are decreasing.

Maya Patel: we still need to understand why policy v3 started preferring `redwood-1b-q8`. That suggests a bad perf-profile ingestion. I'll roll back perf-profile ingestion job and re-run benchmarks.

Samir Khan: rolling back the ingest now and triggering a profile re-benchmark: ```/bench/profile-run --models redwood-7b-fp16,redwood-1b-q8 --sweeps quick```

PD Bot: PagerDuty: handoff scheduled to night oncall at 23:00 UTC (Maya -> Eva).

Eva (SRE): taking handoff at 23:00. For post-incident: 1) postmortem, 2) enforce canary on perf-profile ingestion, 3) add guardrail to prevent manual overrides from creating policy-graph cycles (linter in infra).

Maya Patel: also add a quick dashboard widget showing variant-preference drift across policies; alerted us late. Adding to follow-up.

Alex Chen: final status: mitigation stable, customers impacted reduced to negligible, deny-rule TTL will expire; will coordinate permanent policy patch in the morning. :white_check_mark:

Samir Khan: note for postmortem - we had two human actions: policy push last night and then manual force-model. Combination created emergent loop. We'll propose an operator checklist next time (verify fallback targets before forcing).

IncidentBot: INC-2026-0421 marked as mitigated at 18:10 UTC.

Maya Patel: good work team. I'll open the postmortem draft and assign action items.

Eva (SRE): adding reviewers: @Alex Chen, @Samir Khan.

Alex Chen: thanks everyone. Closing thread after PD handoff. :pray:
